args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`), and a follow-up status check shows the service is now **healthy** (error rate 0.002) in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the health-check failures, and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
